sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COALESCE(r.text, 'No ruling found') as ruling_text, c.hasContentWarning, CASE WHEN c.hasContentWarning = 1 THEN 'Yes - Missing or degraded properties' ELSE 'No' END as has_missing_or_degraded_properties FROM cards c LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.artist = 'Stephen Daniele' ORDER BY c.id, r.date DESC
